newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus stocks slide 1.09 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus stocks slide 1.09 pct in week.

text.p: Cyprus equities slipped 1.09 percent during the week to 74.88 points although analysts expect a rebound next week once the market tests the low of 73.90 points reached on January 31.
The bourse closed the week at 74.88 points, down 0.83 points from 75.72 points on May 23. The sectoral indices of tourist and miscellaneous companies increased while the five other indices fell.
"The way we see things the market will drop some percentage points before it recovers," said one analyst at Share Link.

"If there is a further decline at the beginning of the week then we can expect to see a rally by the end of the week. The market will retest the level of 73.90 and hold at between 72 and 74 points," he said.

CISCO, the Cyprus Investment and Securities Corporation, said in their weekly report that the performance pointed to a bearish and oversold market. . It said the indications were the market could possibly rebound.
Bank of Cyprus shares were trading at 295.5 on Friday, down three cents from 298.5 recorded last weeek. The Cyprus Popular Bank was trading at 294, from 298.5.
The Hellenic Bank dropped four cents to 274.5 and Universal Savings Bank was trading at 180 cents, down three cents from 183 last week.

Blue-chip cement manufacturers Vassiliko were trading shares for 154.5, down four cents from 158.5, and Cyprus Cement were trading their shares for 258, from 264.5. Brewer KEO shares were going for 102.5, up one cent from last week.
National carrier Cyprus Airways was trading at 28.8 cents from 28.6 cents last week.
